correctness.rationale: Polar inclusion K°⊂B^d gives an asymmetric parallelotope in dual unit-vector basis w_i. Independent endpoint random variables T_i at 1/alpha_i and -1/beta_i with mean 0 yield E||∑T_i w_i||²=∑||w_i||²/(alpha_i beta_i)≤1. Since ||w_i||≥1, obtain ∑(alpha_i beta_i)^(-1)≤1. Two exact Cauchy–Schwarz steps and AM–GM yield the sharp quadratic and linear sums; equality forces alpha_i=beta_i=sqrt(d) and orthogonal u_i. Tightness of paired frame implies its d vectors sqrt(a_i²+b_i²)u_i form an orthogonal square matrix, so the polar is an axis-aligned box. Gaussian orthant vertex covariance is D+mm^T with D_ii=(1/a_i+1/b_i)²/4≥2, giving tr sqrt≥sqrt2 d by square-root operator monotonicity, with equality balanced. Independent endpoint probability/moment and equalities were algebraically recomputed. This covers all d>=2 under exactly d independent lines, not arbitrary 2d points.
